scope: Six coding TUIs; ordinary CLI, JSON and prompt-file interoperability
recommendation: Provider-independent ptest CLI, versioned reports, printable repair prompts and one generic checked-in guide; optional thin native entrypoints

matrix.instruction: CLAUDE.md or .claude/CLAUDE.md; @path import; not direct AGENTS.md loading
AGENTS.md; workspace trust applies; exact heading returned with no tools
AGENTS.md; CLAUDE.md fallback; file references not automatically imported
--read PATH or /read PATH; optional .aider.conf.yml read setting

minimum_requirements: No ptest model API, credentials, launcher, MCP or hosted-service dependency
Noninteractive local CLI and file/text handoff, with no required TTY or agent installation
Literal argv and normal runner output/exit preservation; skipped/incomplete is not passed
Versioned JSON with stable finding IDs, evidence, uncertainty and completeness
Clean JSON stdout; diagnostic stderr; separate machine reports from raw runner streams
Deterministic repair prompts from the same finding model, with bounded untrusted evidence
One generic repository guide plus optional native pointers with safe no-overwrite initialization
Never modify global agent configuration, disable approvals, or broaden workspace trust
Separate expected generic compatibility from documented native conventions and tested integration
limitations: No end-to-end ptest integration verified; native-loading smoke limited to Muse
Muse probe executed by orchestrator; raw evidence inspected here; import syntax unverified
No Windows/macOS, version-matrix, cancellation or real-provider compatibility smoke
Aider stable agent JSON output not established; common contract uses ptest output
Proposed flags, schemas and exit distinctions require product-spec approval
